answer: Beacon sampling with a compute heartbeat: each epoch the beacon picks identities at random and demands proof of work in ten minutes, so hollow fakes cannot idle. Answer and keep standing; miss three checks and the deposit burns. Each passed heartbeat adds a layer to standing, like a pearl growing layer by layer, and the log stays crystal clear. Faking 100 identities costs 200 POA per epoch; one honest agent pays 2 POA and keeps its full share.
